PS D:\java\hw> javac Main.java
Main.java:11: 错误: 找不到符号
        System.out.println("sum = " + total);
                                      ^
  符号:   变量 total
  位置: 类 Main
1 个错误
output:
## Why
`Main.java` 第 11 行用到了变量 `total`,但编译器在当前作用域里找不到它的声明。多半是变量名拼写不一致,或者根本没声明。
## Fix
改成你实际声明的变量名,或先声明再使用。
```java
int total = 0;  // 先声明, 再在循环里累加
```
如果你累加用的变量叫别的名字,直接把第 11 行改成那个名字。

        int age = in.nextLine();
                             ^
1 个错误
output:
## Why
`Main.java` 第 7 行把 `nextLine()` 的返回值(`String`)直接赋给了 `int` 变量,类型不匹配,Java 不会自动把字符串转成整数。
## Fix
用 `Integer.parseInt` 转换。
```java
int age = Integer.parseInt(in.nextLine().trim());
```
输入不是数字时会抛 `NumberFormatException`;也可以直接用 `in.nextInt()`。

Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 10 out of bounds for length 10
	at Histogram.main(Histogram.java:9)
output:
## Why
Line 9 of `Histogram.java` reads index 10 of an array of length 10, whose valid indexes are 0–9. This is a classic off-by-one: the loop runs one step too far, usually because its condition uses `<=` instead of `<`.
## Fix
Stop the loop before the length.
```java
for (int i = 0; i < counts.length; i++) {
```
If the index comes from data rather than a loop counter, check it against `length` first.

## Why
`PriceSum.java` line 6 passes the string `"4.5"` to `Integer.parseInt`, which only accepts whole numbers, so it throws `NumberFormatException`.
## Fix
If the values may contain decimals, parse them as `double`.
```java
double total = 0;
total += Double.parseDouble(s);
```
If they must be integers, the input data is wrong and needs cleaning or validation instead.

Exception in thread "main" java.util.ConcurrentModificationException
	at java.base/java.util.ArrayList$Itr.checkForComodification(ArrayList.java:1013)
	at java.base/java.util.ArrayList$Itr.next(ArrayList.java:967)
	at Cleaner.main(Cleaner.java:11)
output:
## Why
The enhanced `for` loop at `Cleaner.java` line 11 iterates over an `ArrayList` while the loop body changes that same list (adds or removes elements). The iterator notices the modification on its next `next()` call and throws.
## Fix
Use `removeIf` (or an explicit `Iterator.remove()`) instead of modifying the list inside the loop.
```java
list.removeIf(item -> item.isEmpty());  // put your own condition here
```

Exception in thread "main" java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException
	at java.base/java.util.AbstractList.add(AbstractList.java:155)
	at java.base/java.util.AbstractList.add(AbstractList.java:113)
	at Playlist.main(Playlist.java:9)

## Why
Line 9 of `Playlist.java` calls `add` on a list that does not support it; the trace shows the default `AbstractList.add` throwing. This typically means a fixed-size list from `Arrays.asList(...)` (or an immutable one from `List.of`).
## Fix
Copy it into a real `ArrayList` before adding.
```java
List<String> list = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(items));
list.add("outro");
```
Remember to import `java.util.ArrayList`.

category: 找不到或无法加载主类
input:
PS D:\code\java\demo> java Main
错误: 找不到或无法加载主类 Main
原因: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: com/example/app/Main (wrong name: Main)
output:
## Why
报错里的 `com/example/app/Main (wrong name: Main)` 说明:这个 `Main.class` 里声明了包 `com.example.app`,但你在同一目录直接用 `java Main` 运行,类名对不上,JVM 因此找不到主类。
## Fix
单文件作业最简单的做法是删除 `package` 声明,重新编译后再 `java Main`。
```java
// 删除 Main.java 中的这一行:
package com.example.app;
```
如果要保留包,用 `javac -d out Main.java` 编译,再运行 `java -cp out com.example.app.Main`。

Main.java:5: 错误: 不兼容的类型: 从double转换到int可能会有损失
        int total = price * qty;
                          ^
1 个错误
output:
## Why
`Main.java` 第 5 行的 `price * qty` 结果是 `double`,却赋给了 `int` 变量。`double` 转 `int` 会丢掉小数部分,Java 不允许隐式地这样做。
## Fix
如果要保留小数,把接收变量改成 `double`。
```java
double total = price * qty;
```
确实只要整数时,才写强制转换 `(int) (price * qty)`。

Exception in thread "main" java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: 年龄必须在 0-150 之间: -3
	at Student.<init>(Student.java:7)
	at Student.main(Student.java:14)
output:
## Why
`Student.java` 第 7 行主动抛出 `IllegalArgumentException`:第 14 行创建对象时传入的年龄是 -3,不在允许的 0-150 范围内。这是构造方法里的参数校验,不是语法错误。
## Fix
传入合法的年龄;如果值来自用户输入,先校验再构造。
```java
Student s = new Student("Tom", 18);  // 年龄改为 0-150 之间
```

$ javac Main.java
Main.java:9: 错误: 无法访问的语句
        System.out.println("搜索结束");
        ^
1 个错误
output:
## Why
`Main.java` 第 9 行的语句位于 `return`(或 `break` / `throw`)之后,永远不会被执行,javac 因此报“无法访问的语句”。
## Fix
把这条语句移到 `return` 之前,或直接删除。
```java
System.out.println("搜索结束");
return -1;
```

output:
## Why
`Main.java` 第 7 行调用了 `Scanner` 上不存在的方法 `nextint()`。Java 区分大小写,正确的方法名是 `nextInt()`。
## Fix
改成正确的大小写。
```java
int n = sc.nextInt();
```

[错误] 读取购物车失败
java.lang.ClassCastException: class java.lang.String cannot be cast to class java.lang.Integer (java.lang.String and java.lang.Integer are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')
	at Cart.main(Cart.java:12)
output:
## Why
The Chinese `[错误]` line is only the program's own message; the real error is `ClassCastException` at `Cart.java` line 12. The object being cast to `Integer` is actually a `String`, so the cast fails.
## Fix
Parse the string instead of casting it (or store an `Integer` in the first place).
```java
int qty = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(value));
```
Here `value` stands for whatever expression you were casting.
